text:
marie: Heads up — noticed a small billing blip for a customer after a prefetch-resume + truncation during streaming. ~10 tokens extra. Anyone seen this?
liam: Huh, do you have logs? Which route?
marie: Route: legacy-prefetch sidecar -> routed to fallback-model when node drained. We resume session; toolcall then truncation occurs mid-tool. Logs: ```INFO ledger_event: session_id=abc123 phase=resume origin=prefetch route=fallback tokens=42 truncated=true
INFO provisional_write: session_id=abc123 type=tool_charge tokens=30 prefix_len=2
INFO confirmed_write: session_id=abc123 type=tool_charge tokens=40 confirmed=true route=other-model
```
sana: Interesting — our ledger stores origin+route but dedupe only checks session_id + confirmed flag. If truncated toolcall creates a provisional tool_charge then resume triggers confirmed charge and both persist.
oliver: Could be retry path swapping model mid-stream and attribution doubles. Our flow increments provisional on chunk send and then confirmed on final ack; if ack path changes we might not dedupe.
marie: Repro steps: run prefetch for 2 tokens, force node drain during a toolcall, reconnect to a different route, then send truncated EOF. I'll drop a tiny repro harness link in #devex.
liam: @sana any chance the console traces show route_hint on the confirmed event? :thinking: 
sana: Console traces show route_hint missing on the confirmed path sometimes — UI groups by model id only. We should add 'session_phase' and 'route_hint' to the token timeline and per-route waterfall.
dev-ops-bot: Alert: 1 customer saw $0.0003 spike; no SLA breach.
oliver: Immediate mitigation: on ledger-ingest, if event.truncated == true and a provisional exists within 10s with same prefix, mark confirmed as merged instead of separate charge. Need to be careful not to hide real double charges.
sana: Proposal: add tag 'resume_source' to confirmed token events, emit metric dedupe_rate and route_mismatch_rate, and show a "merged provisional" tooltip in the console timeline.
marie: Sounds good. Can we get a quick PR: infra to add session_phase on events + UI change for the waterfall? I'll canary it. @oliver can you draft the dedupe rule? :+1:
oliver: On it — will open PR with unit tests and a small harness. ETA EOD.
